# Brisbane Plastics Company

> Brisbane Plastics Company Pty Ltd (ABN 14 699 248 658) makes custom PVC and polypropylene products in Tingalpa, Brisbane, Queensland, Australia. It owns and runs Plastics Unique (custom folders, binders, wallets, satchels, tags and school products) and Sov Services (patient chart folders, chart holders, dividers and glove box holders for hospitals since 1994), and offers UV flatbed printing on rigid sheet up to 1250 x 2500 mm and 50.8 mm thick, with white ink.

- Address: 45a Millennium Place, Tingalpa QLD 4173
- Phone: (07) 3396 3744 or 1300 744 104
- Quotes: sales@brisplastics.com.au; hospital orders: support@sovservices.net.au
- Delivers Australia-wide; all products are made to order in the Tingalpa factory.

## Products (Plastics Unique)

- [Custom PVC & Polypropylene Products](https://brisplastics.com.au/products): Ring binders, notebook covers, glovebox wallets, satchels, tags, compendiums, school and music folders, all custom made in Brisbane. Photos and options for every product.
- [Ring binders and lever arch folders](https://brisplastics.com.au/products/ring-binders): Custom ring binders made in Tingalpa from PVC or polypropylene, in standard or custom sizes. Made in Brisbane.
- [Custom tab dividers and medical ring binders](https://brisplastics.com.au/products/tab-dividers): Custom tab dividers made to your section list, and ring binders for hospitals and medical specialists. Made in Brisbane.
- [Slip boxes for ring binders](https://brisplastics.com.au/products/slip-boxes): Slip boxes protect and present ring binders and lever arch folders. Made to fit any binder size, in matching colours and print.
- [Presentation folders and covers](https://brisplastics.com.au/products/presentation-folders): Presentation folders, compendium covers and diary covers that carry your brand, in PVC or polypropylene with pockets to suit.
- [Display books and sample display folders](https://brisplastics.com.au/products/display-folders): Display books with welded clear sleeves, and custom sample folders that hold carpet, upholstery, tarp, synthetic grass and other swatches for sales. Made in Brisbane.
- [Clipboard folders](https://brisplastics.com.au/products/clipboard-folders): Clipboard folders made to your size and shape, with a metal clip riveted in house and your logo printed on the cover.
- [Pocket notebook covers](https://brisplastics.com.au/products/notebook-covers): Pocket notebook covers for safety pads, promotional giveaways and field notebooks. Top or side opening, soft or hard cover, single or multi-panel.
- [Take 5 safety books and covers](https://brisplastics.com.au/products/take-5-safety-books): Take 5 and Hazob pocket book covers that keep safety pads clean and on site. Ordered with or without the books.
- [Drill pipe tally books and covers](https://brisplastics.com.au/products/tally-books): Custom-branded tally book covers and paper refills for drill pipe tallying, popular with the oil and gas, drilling and mining industries.
- [Glovebox, service book and dealership wallets](https://brisplastics.com.au/products/glovebox-wallets): Glovebox and service book wallets that keep the owner's manual and service book together and put your dealership's name in front of the customer. Made in Brisbane.
- [Fuel card holders](https://brisplastics.com.au/products/fuel-card-holders): Fuel card holders that protect fleet fuel cards and carry the vehicle number, branding or instructions.
- [PVC satchels and document wallets](https://brisplastics.com.au/products/pvc-satchels): Welded PVC satchels and document wallets for keeping papers neat, protected and dry, printed with your logo.
- [Polypropylene satchels and document boxes](https://brisplastics.com.au/products/polypropylene-satchels): Hard-wearing polypropylene satchels, envelopes, letter files and box satchels in clear, tinted or solid colours, printed to order.
- [Travel wallets](https://brisplastics.com.au/products/travel-wallets): Travel wallets for tickets, itineraries and passports, made in a range of sizes, colours and print options at factory-direct prices.
- [TAB and gaming wallets](https://brisplastics.com.au/products/tab-wallets): TAB and gaming wallets in 28 standard colours with any print, including photographic-quality full colour.
- [ID tag pockets and card wallets](https://brisplastics.com.au/products/id-tags): ID tag pockets for conferences, events and site security, and card wallets for student IDs, travel cards and library cards.
- [Branded luggage tags](https://brisplastics.com.au/products/luggage-tags): Luggage tags printed with your logo and branding, with a standard or custom details insert.
- [Noren tags and parts bin tags](https://brisplastics.com.au/products/noren-tags): Noren tags and parts bin tag holders for workshops, service departments and warehouses.
- [Plastic signs, danger tags and isolation tags](https://brisplastics.com.au/products/signs-and-tags): Workplace safety signs and tags made to your specification, popular with construction, maintenance and mining.
- [Room compendiums and menu books](https://brisplastics.com.au/products/room-compendiums): Room compendiums for hotels and private hospitals, and menu books for restaurants, in leather-look or metallic PVC to match your brand.
- [Food service and point-of-sale signage](https://brisplastics.com.au/products/food-service-signage): Custom-made and printed signage for buffets, deli counters, produce displays and venues.
- [Counter mats](https://brisplastics.com.au/products/counter-mats): Counter mats that put your promotion in front of the customer at the point of sale.
- [X-ray protective sleeves](https://brisplastics.com.au/products/x-ray-sleeves): Clear PVC sleeves, sealed at the bottom and open along the top long edge, for storing X-rays or protecting them in transit.
- [In remembrance folders](https://brisplastics.com.au/products/funeral-folders): In remembrance folders that funeral homes give to families, finished to match the funeral home's branding.
- [Student portfolio folders](https://brisplastics.com.au/products/student-portfolios): Two- and three-part student portfolio folders that let graduates keep and display certificates, awards and samples of their work.
- [Certificate pockets and folders](https://brisplastics.com.au/products/certificate-pockets): Certificate display pockets and folders to protect and present graduation and award certificates.
- [School folders and binders](https://brisplastics.com.au/products/school-folders): School-branded ring binders, folders, clipboards and vinyl satchels, fully customised to your school colours and crest.
- [Music folders](https://brisplastics.com.au/products/music-folders): Instrumental and choir music folders for schools, regional ensembles, concert bands, orchestras and choirs, printed with your logo in a wide choice. Made in Brisbane.
- [Rulers, plate frames and promotional items](https://brisplastics.com.au/products/promotional-products): Small branded items made from PVC and polypropylene: rulers, number plate frames, door hangers and more.
- [32-8 bean lids for polystyrene boxes](https://brisplastics.com.au/products/bean-lids): Clear rigid PVC lids for 32-8 polystyrene bean and produce boxes, with die-cut vent holes.
- [Printing, colours and finishing](https://brisplastics.com.au/products/printing-and-finishing): Every product can be finished in house: screen printing, foil stamping, embossing and debossing, full-colour digital and encapsulated print, in our. Made in Brisbane.

## Hospital range (Sov Services)

- [Patient Chart Folders & Holders](https://brisplastics.com.au/hospital/): Australian-made Sov Services patient chart folders, chart holders, clipboards, dividers and glove box holders. Supplying 250+ medical establishments since 1994. Order online.
- [Patient Chart Folders, Printed Ward & Bed](https://brisplastics.com.au/hospital/patient-chart-folders): Polypropylene patient chart folders in 30, 40, 55 and 68 mm spines and ten colours. Ward and bed or custom print, hanging folders. Item codes and online ordering.
- [Patient Chart Holders & Bed Rail Clipboards](https://brisplastics.com.au/hospital/patient-chart-holders): A3 and A4 patient chart holders for the bed rail or wall, and ABS patient clipboards with rollover top. Item codes, sizes and online ordering for hospitals.
- [Patient Chart Dividers, 5-Tab & Custom](https://brisplastics.com.au/hospital/chart-dividers): A4 2-ring patient chart dividers: 5-tab blank, 5-tab printed (Observations, Medications, Fluids, Care Plans, Other) and custom 1 to 10 tabs. Order online.
- [Wall-Mounted Glove Box Holders for Hospitals](https://brisplastics.com.au/hospital/glove-box-holders): Single and triple wall-mounted glove box holders with stainless spring clips, lift-off bracket and add-on basket. Hospital and clinic ordering online.

## UV flatbed printing

- [UV Flatbed Printing Brisbane](https://brisplastics.com.au/uv-printing/): UV flatbed printing in Brisbane on acrylic, PVC, ACM, wood, glass and more. Up to 1250 x 2500 mm and 50.8 mm thick, with white ink. Trade and direct. Tingalpa.
- [Trade UV Flatbed Printing Brisbane](https://brisplastics.com.au/uv-printing/trade): Trade UV flatbed printing in Brisbane for sign shops, printers and designers. Print-ready files, your material or ours, up to 1250 x 2500 mm with white ink. Plain packaging.
- [Acrylic Printing Brisbane](https://brisplastics.com.au/uv-printing/acrylic): Acrylic printing in Brisbane: face, reverse and backlit printing on clear, frosted and coloured acrylic up to 1250 x 2500 mm, with white ink. Trade and direct.
- [PVC & Foamed PVC Sign Printing Brisbane](https://brisplastics.com.au/uv-printing/pvc-signs): PVC sign printing in Brisbane on foamed PVC, rigid PVC, polycarbonate, styrene and corflute. Direct UV print up to 1250 x 2500 mm. Single signs to production runs.
- [ACM & Aluminium Sign Printing Brisbane](https://brisplastics.com.au/uv-printing/acm-aluminium-signs): ACM and aluminium sign printing in Brisbane. Direct UV print on aluminium composite panel up to 1250 x 2500 mm for building, site and property signs. Trade and direct.
- [Safety Signs, Machine Labels & Panel Overlays Brisbane](https://brisplastics.com.au/uv-printing/safety-industrial-signs): Safety signs, machine labels, nameplates and control panel overlays printed in Brisbane on polycarbonate, PVC, ACM and aluminium. Numbered batches and danger tags.
- [POS Display & Retail Sign Printing Brisbane](https://brisplastics.com.au/uv-printing/pos-displays): Retail and POS display printing in Brisbane: counter displays, menu boards, shelf signs and packaging prototypes. Printed, cut, creased and welded in house.
- [Full-Colour Printed PVC & Polypropylene Products](https://brisplastics.com.au/uv-printing/printed-plastic-products): Full-colour printed PVC and polypropylene products made in Brisbane: folders, binders, wallets, tags and menu covers, printed then cut, welded and assembled in house.
- [Office, Reception & Wayfinding Signs Brisbane](https://brisplastics.com.au/uv-printing/office-signs): Office and business signs printed in Brisbane: reception, door, room and wayfinding signs on acrylic, PVC and ACM. Full colour with white ink. One sign or a full fit-out.
- [School Signs & Honour Boards Brisbane](https://brisplastics.com.au/uv-printing/school-signs): School signs printed in Brisbane: campus wayfinding, building and classroom signs, honour boards and sports displays on acrylic, PVC and ACM. From the makers of Plastics Unique school folders.
- [Hospital, Ward & Clinic Signs](https://brisplastics.com.au/uv-printing/hospital-signs): Hospital, clinic and aged care signs printed in Brisbane: ward, room and wayfinding signs on acrylic, PVC and ACM. From the makers of Sov Services patient chart folders.

## Company and ordering

- [Custom PVC & Polypropylene Products Brisbane](https://brisplastics.com.au/): Brisbane Plastics Company, home of Plastics Unique and Sov Services: custom PVC and polypropylene products, hospital chart folders and holders, and UV flatbed printing. Tingalpa.
- [About Brisbane Plastics Company](https://brisplastics.com.au/about): Brisbane Plastics Company, part of FormFill Group, owns and runs Plastics Unique and Sov Services from 26 October 2026. Meet directors Bruce Bairstow and Mathew Bowden.
- [Request a Quote or Reorder](https://brisplastics.com.au/contact): Request a quote, reorder a past job or place an order for custom PVC and polypropylene products. Upload artwork and get a reply within one business day.
- [Hospital Order & Reorder Form](https://brisplastics.com.au/hospital/order): Order or reorder Sov Services patient chart folders, holders, dividers and glove box holders online. Item codes, colours and ward and bed printing.
